{{Otheruses|Lazerian}}
The '''Lazerian space fleet''' was a collection of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] tasked with defending the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. It consisted of two [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigates]] and twenty-four [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]]. It was under the overall command of the [[Lazerian Orbital Command]].<ref name="Kira">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>
